title: Enforcement Decree of the Act on the Public Announcement of Real Estate Values

metadata.completion_statement: This one Decree is fully translated into English, including all six chapters, Articles 1 through 77 and inserted Articles 74-2 and 75-2, and all supplied addenda from Presidential Decree No. 27471 through No. 35947, including every consequential amendment, cross-reference, and omission notice. The translation is MACHINE_TRANSLATION / UNREVIEWED.
